title: Capitalise Each Word
description:
Write `title_case(text)` that trims extra spaces, and makes each word start with a capital and continue in lower case. Words must be joined by single spaces.

Example: `title_case('  aSHA   kumar ')` returns `Asha Kumar`.
solution_code:
def title_case(text):
    return ' '.join(w.capitalize() for w in text.split())
